thread:
emily: Quick heads-up — Peregrine QBR prep. We've surfaced a mid-quarter spike in embeddings (>3x baseline) and customer is asking for spend forecast + mitigation options. Can FinOps and SEs assemble recommended playbook by EOD Thu? :eyes:
raj: I can run a 30/60/90 spend forecast. Do we have recent token breakdown by route? If not I can pull from console. What timeframe for 'mid-quarter' spike — last 7 days?
mike: I pulled last 14 days. Embeddings token count jumped 3.4x, cost +280%. Raw: `embeddings: 1.2M -> 4.1M tokens/day`. I can export a CSV. Also seeing low cache hit rate (11%).
sophie: I'll own customer enablement context — they rolled out vector-heavy search two weeks ago. They've got a naive per-call embedding flow (no batch, no caching). I'll ask their eng PM for call patterns.
emily: Great. Two asks for the QBR deck: 1) conservative spend forecast with best/worst case 2) 3-4 concrete mitigations + estimated $ savings 3) renewal risk flag w/ recommended next steps.
raj: Proposed mitigations: enable prefix KV cache, switch to batched embeddings (n=16), recommend 8-bit quantized model variant for non-realtime flows, and enforce rate-limits per workspace. I'll attach rough savings estimates after mike's CSV.
mike: Quick numbers: batching -> ~3x token efficiency for embeddings path, cache hit from 11% -> target 60% saves ~45% cost. Quantization for embed-only workloads ~30% op cost reduction. I'll add exact %s in the CSV. CSV link: https://redwood-internal/peregrine/costs/2270001234-export.csv
sophie: For enablement, I'll prepare a 20-min runbook to help Peregrine engineering add a local request batching shim and a shared cache. Also prepare suggested SLA talk-track if we propose Dedicated capacity.
emily: Also: alert tuning — their budget alerts fire at 80% then 100% and team is ignoring 80% because noisy. Can we propose a new alert policy: 70% realtime + 95% end-of-day summary + high-severity on spike >200% day-over-day? @mike can you add those to alert playbook?
mike: Yep. I'll add alert rules and sample JSON for notify-hook. snippet:
```
{ "threshold_pct": 70, "window": "24h", "action": "notify#slack" }
{ "spike_multiplier": 2, "window": "1h", "action": "pager#oncall" }
```
emily: Perfect. Last piece: capture customer feedback on model quality drift since they switched — Sophie, collect 3 example queries showing degradation. We'll include that in QBR to balance cost vs quality.
raj: I'll drop the initial forecast table by EOD Thu. Mike/sophie/emily — tag me if you need numbers earlier.
sophie: On it. I'll ping Peregrine PM now and copy follow-up notes here.
emily: Thanks team. We'll sync Tue 10am to finalize deck. :thumbsup:
